notes: Cut the number of different text treatments down so the Control Panel reads as one thing instead of many. 97 style declarations were changed to sit on the ladder the design system already describes: sizes 11/12/13/14/17, four weights, and…
Light text is retired. The design system says outright that it is not consumed, and the app was using it in 27 places, most of which were secondary copy that now sits at normal weight.
Removed tracking from body text. Values like 0.015em are a difference nobody can see and a variation everybody counts; they were multiplying the number of distinct styles for no visible benefit.
